item.title: Siri Remote for Vibe Coding 1.0.2
item.description:
# Siri Remote for Vibe Coding 1.0.2
This maintenance release adds persistent certificate signing so macOS can recognize subsequent updates as the same app.
## Changes
- **Persistent signing:** this release reuses the `siriRemote Local Signing` certificate used by the maintainer's installed 1.0.1. A local replacement test retained Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions across two changed App revisions signed with that certificate. - **Consistent build and release signing:** a shared signer handles the App, Sparkle components and credential broker. Local signing preferences apply to release builds as well as local builds. - **Fail safely:** when stable signing is selected, an unavailable certificate fails the build instead of silently switching to ad-hoc signing. - **Documentation:** updated build instructions and local signing guidance. Existing layouts, macros, push-to-talk settings, Voice data and bundle identifiers are preserved.
## Upgrade
In the App, choose **Tuning → Software Updates → Check for Updates…**, then install 1.0.2. Updates still use this fork's existing Sparkle Ed25519 key to authenticate the archive.
The public 1.0.1 archive was ad-hoc signed. Moving from that archive to this certificate may require permission approval once. A 1.0.1 already signed with this same local certificate is expected to retain its permissions; this release is intended to test that path through Sparkle.
The App is self-signed, **not Apple-notarized**. This does not provide Apple Developer ID trust on other Macs. Initial installation may require **right-click → Open / Open Anyway**. Keep Gatekeeper enabled. macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon is required.
## Downloads
- **App only:** `SiriRemoteVibe-1.0.2-macOS-arm64.zip`; also used by the in-app updater. - **Native Full Setup:** `SiriRemoteVibe-Full-Setup-1.0.2-arm64.pkg`; installs the App and optional Siri Remote Mic components. The installer package is unsigned. - **Alternative Full Setup:** `SiriRemoteVibe-Full-Setup-1.0.2-arm64.zip`. - **Checksums:** `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
Sparkle updates the App only. Use Full Setup for microphone system-component changes. Apple's PacketLogger is still a separate prerequisite for remote microphone capture and is not bundled.
